qualifications.text: Static source/proposed-authorship review only. All five incomplete contracts remain unaccepted and unapplied. No canonical, catalog, index, queue, handoff or GitHub change.
Current source, acquisition, class-school routes and six native placements are preserved. Access eligibility is not evidence of an acquired, prepared, legally paid live cast.

The ten component records have bounded before/after states, not complete actor/world states. Replay verifies data transforms only; actual profiles, legal timing, payment, resource and custody histories remain mandatory for complete positive spell witnesses.
No runtime, implementation, human-play, playtest, balance, cosmology, domain-closure, completion or release gate is opened.

Closed comparator acceptances retain exact indexed envelopes and scope. AFP211-E01 is CLOSED. A lower spell profile, duration, permission, healing classification or information field does not automatically authorize a rank9 effect.
All unrelated holds and prior accepted/applied decisions are unchanged, including MF210-B01/B02, IR207-B02 and IE204-B02. No re-review of those identities.

Missing source facts stay missing, distinct from false, absent, Neutral, zero or permission granted. No unstated profile quantities, reputation scales, institutional rights, cures, physical geometry or cosmology are invented.

deliverySelfHash: Not self-referential; exact delivery SHA-256 recorded in the external local transfer receipt.
